items.method: Cross-read the cash-market internals — market-heatmap breadth against its 60% broad-participation threshold — against the single-name options tape (call-versus-put premium, call fraction and the heaviest same-session prints) and the options-structure corridor (negative dealer gamma, flip, put and call walls, expected move), then judge whether concentrated call demand into narrowing breadth is a broad bid or a late-leadership divergence, and anchor a direction-correct invalidation to the gamma-flip level above spot whose reclaim would falsify the caution.
items.note: The genuinely new signature this window is a divergence that was not present earlier in the day: the cash tape has narrowed while the derivative tape has grown more one-sidedly bullish. Market-heatmap breadth has slipped to 44.72% of 134 constituents positive — a 15.28-point shortfall against the 60% broad-participation line and a reversal from the broad reading carried into the prior window — so fewer names are carrying the index. At the same time single-name option premium is call-heavy at a 0.6651 call fraction, $1.873B of call premium against $0.943B of put premium across 12 tickers with 1450 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days, and all three of the most unusual prints are same-session mega-cap calls: AMD 480 calls at $8.3M on 20.5x open interest, MSFT 490 calls at $6.8M and GOOGL 347.5 calls at $1.9M. Narrowing participation with call demand chasing a handful of leaders is a classic late-leadership signature rather than a broad-based bid. The structure model frames the mechanical setting: SPY sits in negative dealer gamma with spot near 765.96 wedged between the 765 put wall and the 766 call wall, about three points under the 769 flip and inside a plus-or-minus 2.88 expected move, and the intraday auction is a Range day pinned to a 765.07 VWAP. This is a caution read on the index — participation is thinning under a pinned tape at a negative-gamma inflection. Watch a sustained loss of the 765 put wall in negative gamma as the confirming trigger that accelerates the move down; the caution is invalidated on a daily close above ~769.00 on SPY, which reclaims the gamma flip, flips dealers positive and releases the corridor upward.
items.title: The cash tape has narrowed (heatmap breadth 44.72% of 134, a 15.28-point miss of the 60% line) even as single-name call premium concentrates into mega-cap calls (AMD 480C $8.3M 20.5x OI, MSFT 490C, GOOGL 347.5C) with SPY pinned between the 765 put wall and 766 call wall in negative dealer gamma just under the 769 flip — call demand pressing a narrowing tape

items.method: Cross-read three independent internals — market-heatmap breadth against its 60% threshold, the sector RRG rotation states and accelerations, and the bond model's high-yield-versus-investment-grade price-ratio read — to test whether they are cooling together into a defensive cluster, then, finding no direction-correct price level on a single committed-universe instrument that expresses the cluster, withhold a tactical call rather than publish one that cannot be scored.
items.note: The new cross-model pattern this window is that three independent internals cooled together rather than in isolation. The breadth model narrowed — 44.72% of 134 constituents positive, a 15.28-point miss of the 60% line and a reversal from the broad reading carried earlier. The sector-rotation model is tilting defensive on the same tape: XLP is Leading with acceleration +4.12 and XLV is a Leading co-leader at +2.56, while energy XLE reads Peaking with acceleration turned negative at -0.48 and rotates out. And the bond-regime model, which read the high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio as strengthening into the prior window, now reads it as mixed across both aligned pairs (jnk-lqd, hyg-lqd) through 2026-08-25 — a loss of the earlier risk-on confirmation. Defensive leadership plus a cooling credit-proxy alongside narrowing breadth is a coherent risk-internals-softening signature. This is a structural observation, not a scoreable trade: the cluster does not resolve to a single committed-universe instrument with a direction-correct price level this window — the credit read is explicitly withheld by its owner for want of an independent spread series, and the rotation and breadth reads are relative and breadth measures, not price triggers — so a tactical call is withheld rather than published with only a working side. Watch whether breadth reclaims the 60% participation line and XLE returns to a Leading acceleration, which would undo the defensive cluster; until an instrument-level price trigger is in view, the cluster is carried as evidence for the index-level caution, not as its own call.
items.title: Internals are turning defensive as a cross-model cluster this window — heatmap breadth narrowed to 44.72%, sector rotation is tilting into staples and healthcare (XLP and XLV Leading) out of energy (XLE Peaking), and the bond model's high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio has cooled from strengthening to mixed
